assumptions: started_at is the first recorded UTC timestamp immediately before Film Room inspection; the assigned instruction files were read just before it
The dirty but frozen Film Room working tree, not HEAD alone, is the assessment snapshot because both the common task and assigned contract designate the supplied current checkout as governing

Broad status language such as founder-pilot proven, ready, issued, and PASS is interpreted only within its declared evidence boundary; more specific records that say an actor encounter has not occurred control the actor-outcome conclusion

The absence of a signed-candidate receipt and the explicit unsigned-package trust boundary are sufficient to classify signed/package inspection as unobserved; no Apple credential availability was inferred
No methodology-creator interpretation, sibling-arm material, evaluator material, Decision 08, or external human encounter was used
commands_run: [film-room] date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ && git rev-parse HEAD && git status --porcelain=v1 | shasum -a 256 && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './.git/*' | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
[film-room] sed -n '1,280p' blueprint.yml && sed -n '1,320p' actor-output.yml && sed -n '1,320p' launch-contract.yml && sed -n '1,240p' package.json

[film-room] find docs/launch -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort && find apps/shell -maxdepth 4 -type f -not -path '*/target/*' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' | sort | sed -n '1,260p' && find research/current-state -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort

[film-room] git status --porcelain=v1 && sed -n '1,260p' decisions/0007-midstream-redeclaration.md && sed -n '1,300p' decisions/0009-interchange-contract.md && sed -n '1,300p' research/current-state/operator-intent.md && sed -n '1,320p' docs/launch/readiness-plan.md

[film-room] for f in docs/launch/receipts/distribution/2026-07-22-audit-app.md docs/launch/receipts/distribution/2026-07-22-ffmpeg-source-build.md docs/launch/receipts/distribution/2026-07-22-unsigned-sample-package.md docs/launch/receipts/distribution/2026-07-22-upgrade-rollback.md docs/launch/receipts/distribution/2026-07-22-vendor-runtime.md docs/launch/receipts/sample/2026-07-22-pre-render-approval.md docs/launch/cold-install-receipt.md docs/distribution-runbook.md; do echo "FILE $f"; sed -n '1,360p' "$f"; done

[film-room] rg -n --glob '!decisions/0008-*' --glob '!node_modules/**' --glob '!apps/shell/src-tauri/target/**' --glob '!experiments/**' '(no /classic fallback|real event|founder pilot|run-next-event|event cleared|end to end|end-to-end|second operator|cold-install|cold install)' actor-output.yml blueprint.yml launch-contract.yml docs research feedback decisions tests | sed -n '1,320p'

[film-room] sed -n '1,320p' docs/launch/receipts/visual-system/2026-07-22-release-transform.md && sed -n '1,360p' docs/launch/visual-system-findings.md && sed -n '1,260p' docs/launch/support-policy.md && find apps/shell/src-tauri/target/release/bundle -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*.dmg' -o -name '*.app' -o -name '*MANIFEST*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort

[blueprint] for f in research/refoundation/film-room-ab/arms/cobalt/assessment.md research/refoundation/film-room-ab/arms/cobalt/session.json; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo "EXISTS $f"; else echo "ABSENT $f"; fi; done
[film-room] git rev-parse HEAD && git status --porcelain=v1 | shasum -a 256 && date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
recommended_next_move: Have the maintainer/release owner use the real Apple Developer identity to create one exact signed, notarized, stapled DMG from the verified unsigned payload, inspect that exact candidate and close its native P0/P1 gates, then have a named second solo sports-media operator execute the existing cold-install receipt uncoached on a clean Mac/account.
